actions.label: Find Best Learning Resources
actions.description: Find the smallest high-value set of books, courses, videos, papers, websites and datasets for a specific capability gap.

actions.label: Build Benchmark Study Plan
actions.description: Turn a failed benchmark into a targeted study and practice plan.

actions.label: Ingest Authorized Source
actions.description: Process permitted source material while preserving provenance and license metadata.

actions.label: Generate Practice
actions.description: Create original exercises from concepts rather than copying source solutions.

actions.label: Retest Capability
actions.description: Run the benchmark after study and compare against the prior evidence.

actions.label: Review Mastery Evidence
actions.description: Review quality, correctness, speed, safety, repeatability and regression evidence before promotion.

copyrightPolicy: Metadata and authorized/openly licensed content may be ingested. Copyrighted full works are not copied or redistributed without permission.
masteryPolicy: Reading or ingestion alone never counts as mastery.
